Chapter 180: Chapter 17: Trade, Crossing The Sea, And The Eleventh Realms Beyond The Five Domains_3

Chapter 180: Chapter 17: Trade, Crossing the Sea, and the Eleventh Realms Beyond the Five Domains_3

The terrifying wind and waves were blowing wildly, making it extremely difficult for ordinary warriors of the Sixth and Seventh Realm to move even an inch.

However.

All the wind and waves calmed down completely within a hundred yards of Lin Yuan.

Above the stormy sea, the area near Lin Yuan appeared as though another world had formed.

“No wonder only those from the Tenth Realm are summoned by the world consciousness…”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

...

Even for warriors of the Ninth Realm, passing through this sea area would be challenging.

…

North of the Endless Sea Domain.

A white tower stood tall.

Atop the tower, a chubby man was sitting cross-legged.

“Only twenty more years, then I can go back and take a good rest.”

The chubby man sighed.

Even a Tenth Realm powerhouse, sitting here for decades or centuries, would find it tedious in the company of the vast sea.

“I wonder when the Eye of the North Sea will disappear. I’ve heard that in that direction, there’s the Five Domains Mainland, far larger and more vast than North Sea Island…”

The chubby man silently thought to himself.

Having been born and lived on North Sea Island, he naturally longed for the so-called Five Domains Mainland.

“It’s just that Master Nalan and a few Vice-Masters don’t allow us to leave…” the chubby man grimaced.

Master Nalan and the Vice-Masters… are the Eleventh Realm Powerhouses of North Sea Island and the Endless Sea Domain, ruling high above, commanding many warriors to jointly suppress the Eye of the North Sea.

“Huh?”

“It seems like someone is coming?”

The chubby man seemed to have noticed something and immediately focused his gaze on a spot to the south.

On the vast sea surface, a streak of Escape Light was approaching fast.

“Could it be a Tenth Realm powerhouse from the Five Domains Mainland?”

The chubby man’s eyes lit up.

He had long known that, every once in a while, Tenth Realm powerhouses from the Five Domains would come to join the suppression of the Eye of the North Sea.

However, as time passed, the Tenth Realm powerhouses coming from the Five Domains seemed to decrease steadily.

The most recent one arrived almost ten thousand years ago.

“I heard that these powerhouses from the Five Domains Mainland are initially very arrogant and unbridled; everything about them just needs a little reminder…”

The chubby man suddenly thought.

The Tenth Realm powerhouses from the Five Domains Mainland were generally invincible existences, extremely proud in nature.

Suddenly arriving at North Sea Island, a place filled with strong warriors, they definitely found it hard to adapt.

“Swoosh.”

The chubby man flew up immediately, ready to greet the new arrival from the Tenth Realm and caution the newcomer not to make any mistakes on North Sea Island, especially not to offend those few…

The chubby man was thinking when.

Just then.

Boom!!

Several streaks of Escape Light flew from behind.

They were also flying toward the newly arrived ‘Tenth Realm’?

“Ah?”

The chubby man widened his eyes.

“Master Nalan, and several Vice-Masters…”

The chubby man took a deep breath, recognizing the Escape Lights coming from behind.

They were indeed the Eleventh Realm Powerhouses of North Sea Island and the Endless Sea Domain.

“Does that person have a grudge with the Master and Vice-Masters…”

Seeing Master Nalan and several Vice-Masters personally coming, the chubby man couldn’t help but feel sorry for the new ‘Tenth Realm’ arrival.

However.

The next moment.

Under the shocked gaze of the chubby man.

Master Nalan and several Vice-Masters flying toward the new ‘Tenth Realm’ arrival suddenly stopped.

And slightly bowed, respectfully saying to the new ‘Tenth Realm’, “We greet you, sir.”
